input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: Argument.get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) unconditionally, but self.help can be None. The previous code substituted "" in format_arguments via `or (metavar, "")`, and that fallback was removed.
- rationale: Trigger: a command where at least one Argument has help set and another has help=None, so the help section is rendered. The None description is passed to formatter.write_dl, which wraps or processes the text and raises TypeError or AttributeError. Impact: --help crashes.
critique: The finding describes the same mechanism as the label. get_help_record returns self.help, which can be None, the fallback in format_arguments was removed, and write_dl crashes on the None description when one argument has help and another does not.
